images.caption: Cottage at Delgatie Castle This curious cottage stands at the foot of the path up to the castle. It looks as if it is an older cottage which has been embellished with Gothic finials and carvings. The shield above the door bears the main elemant of the coat of arms of the Hay family, three shields, and on either side are depictions of the family emblem, an ox-yoke.

images.caption: Garden at Delgatie Castle Captain Hay of Delgatie had this pond excavated, and a waterfall created, in the informal part of the castle gardens. Sadly, the garden is becoming rather unkempt, and the waterfall is overgrown.

images.caption: Mystery Structure We have no real idea what this structure is or was. There are steps down into the water at the far end, and there is an overshot water wheel in front of the hut in the centre of the far side, but no obvious way of supplying water to it. The pool itself looks grubby, but not stagnant. Note the cottage and doocot beyond.

images.caption: Unknown Flower at Delgatie Castle There were several plants in the flowerbed alongside the pergola leading to the castle from the garden. Neither the gardener, nor any of our party, knows what they are.

images.caption: West Wing, Delgatie Castle To the west of the original castle is a curious series of additions. The nearest arch is the exterior of the chapel, then there is a room beyond. After that there is an over-ornate Gothic-style wall, which looks like the front of a doocot, but with the holes blocked with half-bricks. The final appendage resembles a mediaeval knight's tomb, but again there is just a free-standing wall with nothing behind it. In my opinion these follies detract from the simple lines of the old castle.

images.caption:
A Very Unusual Waterwheel This waterwheel at Delgatie Castle works on a circulation system, water is 
pumped up from below the waterwheel and directed onto the wheel from the pipe above.The force of the water, from the pipe drives the wheel. I have seen many

water wheels in my lifetime but I have never seen one powered from above before.
